**Direct answer:** Black Condor II (Ryan Kendall) died in *Infinite Crisis* #1, cover-dated December 2005.

**Claims and sources**

- Ryan Kendall, the second Black Condor, died in *Infinite Crisis* #1 (December 2005).
  https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(New_Earth)
  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor

- He was killed in an ambush by the Secret Society of Super Villains while he was with the Freedom Fighters. A beam apparently fired by Sinestro killed him.
  https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor
  https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(New_Earth)

- He later became a Black Lantern in *Blackest Night*. In Prime Earth continuity, Batman resurrected him with a Black Lantern ring in *Dark Nights: Death Metal* #5. This is background and not part of the death itself.
  https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(Prime_Earth)

**Caveats**
- The Fandom page returned an error when I tried to open it directly. The Fandom claims above come from search-result summaries of that page, not from a full read.
- I read the Wikipedia page only for the death issue and cause. It was long, and I didn't read its last ~11,800 characters.
